definitions.explanation: Reducing the time needed for a task or activity. Short for {時間短縮|じかんたんしゅく}. Very commonly used in everyday life, especially about cooking, housework, and work tasks.
Reduced operating hours, especially of restaurants and shops. Became extremely common during COVID-19 when businesses were asked to close early.

examples.japanese: {時短|じたん}⟦レシピ→レシピ：07157_reshipi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
{時短|じたん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食洗機|しょくせんき}→食洗機：19300_shokusenki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a dishwasher to save time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{時短|じたん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦コツ→コツ：06658_kotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me some tips for cutting down on morning preparation time.

examples.japanese: {時短営業|じたんえいぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{知|し}らせ→お知らせ：18843_oshirase⟧。

examples.english: That shop is on shortened hours and closes at 8 PM now.

examples.japanese: {時短要請|じたんようせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じて→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧、⟦{営業時間|えいぎょうじかん}→営業時間：18476_eigyoujikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{短縮|たんしゅく}しました→短縮する：26835_tanshukusuru⟧。
examples.english: In response to the request to shorten hours, we reduced our operating hours.

notes: Abbreviation of {時間短縮|じかんたんしゅく}. Can function as a noun modifier: {時短|じたん}⟦レシピ→レシピ：07157_reshipi⟧ (quick recipe), {時短|じたん}テク (time-saving technique), {時短|じたん}⟦グッズ→グッズ：10800_guzzu⟧ (time-saving goods). Also used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {時短|じたん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to save time). The sense of 'shortened business hours' became widespread during the COVID-19 pandemic, often appearing in {時短営業|じたんえいぎょう} (reduced-hours operation) and {時短要請|じたんようせい} (request to shorten hours).
